story.vex: A vague 'seems secure' is all the gap I ever need. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every misuse has a specific answer, before a line of code exists. Astro: "Six sharp questions beat one vague feeling, every time."

ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read threat-list.txt: four possible misuses of the new supply tool. Classify each by its STRIDE category.

1. type threat-list.txt
2. classify <threat> spoofing | tampering | repudiation | info-disclosure | denial-of-service | elevation-of-privilege
files.C:\\Citadel\\threat-list.txt:
POSSIBLE MISUSES — supply tool
---------------------------------
threat-1   a requisition could be submitted claiming to be from Command when it isn't
threat-2   a cadet could later deny submitting a request, with no log to prove otherwise
threat-3   the full inventory count could leak to a rival crew watching the network
threat-4   a regular cadet could find a way to gain approver-level access

steps.title: Volt's Drill: read the threat list
steps.body: Volt: "Read every possible misuse before you tag a single one." `type threat-list.txt`.

steps.title: Sort into STRIDE
steps.body: Volt: "Pretending to be someone else is spoofing. Denying with no proof is repudiation. Leaking data is info-disclosure. Gaining access you shouldn't have is elevation-of-privilege." Classify all four.
